evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To bridge this gap, we introduce DiagTrace, a source-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can reconstruct the documented diagnostic trajectory through interactive information seeking.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on medical question answering and diagnostic reasoning benchmarks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: DiagTrace contains 510 cases across eight specialties, with 225 used to evaluate four LLMs on clinical-course alignment, interaction quality, and efficiency.
